finding: Phase 0.18 found the infrastructure layer to be ALREADY CONFORMANT. No migration work was required.
method: Swept all 48 Services plus Models and Http for external HTTP calls, SDK usage and file-system writes outside the Laravel Storage/Image facades. Result: ZERO Services make external HTTP calls. Every external integration already sits behind a contract in app/Infrastructure.

modules.note: Services\ExchangeRateService resolves the contract, never the concrete client (constructor: ?ExchangeRateApiClientInterface $apiClient = null, resolved via app()). Contract injection is therefore already correct.

RazorpayPaymentGateway implements the Domain contract App\Domain\Payment\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface, but the adapter lives in the Payments subtree rather than directly under Payments/. Cosmetic only; not moved because payment is a hard stop.
Both implement the Domain contracts PartnerCommissionRepositoryInterface and SettlementRepositoryInterface.

conclusion: The Phase 0.12 infrastructure work already delivered contracts-plus-adapters for every external dependency. Phase 0.18 correctly left this layer alone rather than performing cosmetic churn.
